The interior is now dark and mauve-tinted and reads as smoked glass: m03 interior (660,330) #1f181b and shelf (620,420) #1f171a, against omaat_room_32 interior (800,300) #21211f. previousIssues.issue: w11b LOW: bar bottles opaque milky white, cobalt fridge bands, white tumblers

The bottles are dark see-through-looking bodies with white labels (m05 (660,350) #151b20; samchui_render_11 (580,300) #3c3a3b and (610,300) #5f5755), but they have no edge highlights, so they read as black wine bottles. The fridge bands are muted, at #1a2a68. The tumblers are now black pucks (m05 (250,440) #0a0c0e) with no rim or highlight, where the render's rocks glasses read as clear glass with bright rims. Low.

issues.problem: The bottles and tumblers have no specular cue, so the glass reads as solid black. The bottles look like wine bottles and the tumblers like rubber pucks. In samchui_render_11, every bottle has a bright vertical edge highlight and a light shoulder, and the rocks glasses show bright rims and base highlights.
issues.fix: In bottle() in 10_mono.js: add a gQuad(0.005, bodyH*0.8) edge highlight at +x 0.4r on the front face in a new MONMAT.glassHi { c: '#cfd6d8', r: 0.1, e: 0.05 }, plus a small shoulder highlight. Lift bottleClear to about #2c3438. Tumbler: an open lathe (rim ring gTorus/gCyl r 0.03, h 0.006) in glassHi over a #2a2e31 body at r 0.04, so each glass shows a bright ring and a dark centre.

issues.detail: Welcome cabinet latch and stiles (m03, m16)
issues.problem: A round knob overhangs the left stile. omaat_room_32 and lalf_133 show an oval thumb-latch set in a lens-shaped bulge of a wider (~0.06 m) stile.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley: replace the knob gCyl with gRBox(0.08, 0.14, 0.02, 0.04, 2) in welcomeChar on the left stile, plus a gRBox(0.035, 0.06, 0.012, 0.017, 2) oval in MONMAT.latch. Widen the stiles to 0.06.

issues.detail: Brewer pot facets (m09, m01, m12, m16)
issues.problem: The per-wedge baked highlights give hard vertical facet stripes, so the pot reads as polygonal rather than polished-round.
issues.evidence: m09 x 505-560 y 330-395: alternating flat bands with hard edges.
issues.fix: Raise the jug lathe segment count (e.g. 12 -> 24), and interpolate the baked highlight per vertex rather than per wedge (cos-azimuth vertex colours), so the bands blend.

issues.problem: Galley inserts have no aluminium perimeter frames or rivets and no cart channel posts. The flight-deck hinge jamb is narrow. The ash-flap frames are cool-tinted and square-cornered, and the 1 px m04 seam remains. The bassinet bar remains. The jump-seat straps read as rods.
issues.evidence: m09/q19 frameless faces against sans_38/sansY_44. m19 jamb x 432-442 against tpa_Image-2-3 x 200-260. m04 (320,350) #848b96 against lalf_133 (150,505) #9c9084; seam m04 x 464. m08 (270,357).
issues.fix: Insert faces: a 0.012 MONMAT.alu gRBox frame ring behind each insert slab, plus 0.03 alu channel posts between carts. Jamb: gBox(0.09, doorH, 0.01) MONMAT.alu plus a 0.3 m pull handle. Flap frames: warm the alu tint (c '#a8a59f') and use gRBox with corner radius 0.03; merge the middle flap into one quad. Bassinet: two small discs in place of the bar.

gapWorth03Note: None. The two medium issues (welcome cabinet, cloud wall) and the brewer pot are fixed, and every remaining item is low and local. The largest remaining single change is aluminium perimeter frames and channel posts on all galley inserts and carts (sans_38/sansY_44). It touches four detail rows, but I estimate about +0.15 to +0.2 overall, not 0.3. Lavatory exteriors (7.6) are the lowest row, but no single defect there dominates.
